topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's objectives, reviewing progression models and framing the study of cancer hallmarks and molecular mechanisms.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades disrupt normal cell proliferation and survival control.

topics.label: Differentiation block in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic alterations prevent progenitor and stem-derived cells from achieving terminal differentiation in both hematological cancers and solid carcinomas.

topics.label: Mechanisms of resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how mutations altering p53, Bax, and BCL2 activity disrupt mitochondrial membrane permeabilization and prevent programmed cell death.

topics.label: Telomere biology, replicative immortality, and senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cells regulate telomere shortening and senescence barriers, how cancers reactivate telomerase to achieve immortality, and how stress pathways enforce cell cycle arrest.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and the Warburg effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how cancer cells alter their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle enzyme mutations, and epigenetic feedback loops to meet biosynthetic demands.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascularization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains why growing tumors require angiogenesis for nutrient supply and how the balance between pro- and anti-angiogenic factors governs vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and dissemination of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological steps, anatomical routes, diagnostic markers, and genomic features involved in metastatic dissemination and colonization.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with summary observations on cancer hallmarks, references to advanced literature, and housekeeping details for upcoming practicals.
